_comment: Damage reflection, design step 9c (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 14): the searched ATTACK HOLD.
USER 2026-11-17 ~20:45: 'One slightly messy case is if we need to Guilty Conscience and Loren's Escape next
turn. We need to not always attack in the meantime.' A settled Boros Reckoner carries Guilty Conscience on
turn 3; only Mountains are out, so Loran's Escape ({W}) is not castable this turn. ATTACKING deals 3, GC deals
3 back, the Reckoner reflects 3 and dies: the opponent is at 14 with nothing left that can deal damage (the
library is all Plains), so there is no win by turn 6. HOLDING keeps it: turn 4 draws a Plains, the Escape makes
the GC'd Reckoner indestructible, it attacks, and GC + its reflection loop to the kill on turn 4. The
generic attack policy always swings, so before step 9c this board did not win.
